criteria.F1_false_elimination: Among policies feasible at L2, the fraction rejected at L0 or L1 must be <= 0.05. Evaluable only with at least 10 L2-feasible policies; otherwise reported as underpowered, not as a pass.
criteria.F2_top_k_retention: Every policy among the L2 top 5 by the registered sort key must be promoted past L1. Applies to all corpus policies, feasible or not.
criteria.F3_descriptive: Spearman rank correlation between L1 and L2 sort-key ranks, L1 reject rate and L2 feasibility rate are reported without a pass threshold.
criteria.decision: The ladder passes for a task when F1 (if evaluable) and F2 hold. A failure means the ladder must change prospectively, with budgets recertified, before that task's search; it is never relabeled as a pass.
criteria.rung_rules: L0 validity-only; L1 promotes when normalized energy <= max_normalized_energy (or None) and summed primitive shortfall <= max_summed_primitive_shortfall, exactly as in evolution/ladder.py and the frozen v3 task files.

purpose: P1 G-ladder fidelity audit of the frozen v3 ladders; no search.
